_about: The cross-embodiment showreel: one face capture played to every robot. scripts/showreel.py records each robot (record), voices the steps' text (voice: ElevenLabs if ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is set, else macOS say), and builds docs/recordings/<out> (build). Each step's words must stay true to the code: what a robot's files turn on is what it is said to do. A step's explain is an explainer from docs/animations shown with it: behind a card (full) or as an inset; a still is a frame of a clip, cropped (x, y, w, h at 1280 x 720).
title: One face, four robots
tag: One face capture · the same gamerobotd and behaviours · simulated in MuJoCo

steps.title: gameRobotics
steps.caption: Easier to build, faster to iterate on
steps.text: We're making advanced robotics easier to build and faster to iterate on. Here's how: design robots visually, simulate and train behaviours, then deploy directly to real hardware, all in one platform. Go from idea to working robot faster than ever.

explain.label: Design, simulate, train, deploy: one platform

steps.title: LexJR · six joints
steps.caption: Brain and body apart · the brain decides what, the body works out how
steps.text: Here's the idea: keep the brain and the body apart. The brain decides what to do; the body works out how to do it. We gave one curious character to four different bodies, starting with LexJR.

explain.label: Under the hood: the eyes lead, the body follows

steps.title: Pan tilt · two joints
steps.caption: Two servos · the same brain, using what this body can do
steps.text: Swap in a body with just two servos, and the brain doesn't change. The body says what it can do, and the brain uses what's there. No special cases.

explain.label: Under the hood: the app's slots: gaze, approach, tilt. The pan tilt fills only gaze

steps.title: Rover · two wheels
steps.caption: Wheels · the brain asks the same; the body steers and drives
steps.text: Now a body on wheels. To the brain, nothing changed: it still asks to look and to keep its distance. The body turns that into steering and driving.

explain.label: Under the hood: gamerobotd's diff drive turns the motion into wheel speeds

steps.title: Rover pan tilt · two bodies in one
steps.caption: Two bodies blended into one · the same brain, zero new code
steps.text: And here's where it gets magical: blend two bodies into one. The head that glances and the base that drives become a single body, and the same brain drives it straight away, with zero new code.

explain.label: Under the hood: the same staggered gaze, with the base as the body

steps.title: One brain, four bodies
steps.caption: The same moment, side by side
steps.text: One brain, four bodies. Build the brain once, and give it the next body you describe.

steps.title: From idea to atoms
steps.caption: gameRobotics
steps.text: From simulation to real-world robotics, we're making it easier than ever to bring your ideas to life. Build faster, experiment freely, and push the boundaries of what's possible. Game Robotics. From idea to atoms.

explain.label: Same daemon, same app, same tick: only the robot's files and its I/O change
